n.story:
Your role is shifting from manual measurement and routine monitoring to high-tech site oversight. While the heavy physical labor of dredging and dam construction remains human-led due to the unpredictable nature of aquatic environments, the 'invisible' work is being taken over by AI. You no longer spend hours manually measuring water depths or checking pump pressures; instead, a network of IoT sensors and autonomous drones feeds real-time data to your tablet, highlighting exactly where a concrete structure is weakening or where a slope needs adjustment.
